notablePrerequisites:
Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one Triskelavite.
description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
The Triskelavite enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Triskelavite you control.
Activate a Triskelavite by sacrificing it, targeting Triskelavus.
The damage that would be dealt to Triskelavus is prevented by Vigor, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
